thread:
incident-bot: PAGERS: model-warmup failure spike detected on cluster us-west-2-gpu-pool-7 — multiple init OOMs and deserialization timeouts. Auto-escalation to oncall.
oncall: Acknowledge. I'm investigating. @maria you up? :rotating_light:
maria: on it, pulling logs from the warmup service now. seeing repeated `OOM: failed allocate` during artifact deserialize.
devon: linking recent changes — we rolled kernel selection logic yesterday for 8-bit quant paths, could be related.
lee: CPU pressure also spiking on the nodes that are OOMing, KV cache churn high.
emily: customer impact? any 5xxs from frontend?
oncall: yes, we have elevated 503s for a handful of customers hitting large-context models. Rate limited/failed warmups causing routing fallback.
tomas: grabbing a sample log from one of the crashed pods:
```
2026-03-17T14:02:11Z ERROR warmup: artifact deserialize failed: EOF while reading
2026-03-17T14:02:11Z ERROR runtime: OOM: cannot reserve 12.7GB for model weights
2026-03-17T14:02:12Z WARN compile: kernel selection timed out after 120s for layer attention
```
maria: interesting — deserialize EOF + immediate OOM suggests artifact corruption or async paging thrash. Node reports heavy swap and CUDA driver resets.
devon: I see telemetry — KV cache miss rate jumped 6x at 14:01:30. Could be thundering herd: many replicas trying warmup simultaneously after deploy.
sre_lead: mitigation options: 1) cordon/evict problematic node(s) 2) reduce warmup concurrency globally 3) fallback to smaller model variant for affected routes 4) restart warmup service with backoff fix.
lee: recommending immediate global warmup concurrency -> 1 (from 4). I'll push config now.
oncall: done. Changed warmup.max_concurrency=1 across us-west-2. Observability: warmup queue length dropping.
emily: reduced 503s from the customer panel but one large customer still seeing degraded latencies.
maria: performing artifact checksum verify on models that failed. Found 3 artifacts with partial downloads (size mismatch).
devon: patching warmup to re-fetch artifact on checksum mismatch rather than continue, pushing canary to 2 nodes.
oncall: also manually evicting node us-west-2g-17 showing repeated CUDA_RESET. Eviction scheduled.
tomas: note — compile timeout for kernel selection still occuring on a subset; those fall back to interpreter path but at cost to latency.
lee: eviction completed, node removed from pool. New nodes are healthy and starting warmup.
emily: customer update: told affected customers we mitigated and are rolling fixes, offered workaround to pin older model version. They accepted for 2 high-SLAs.
maria: follow-up actions: 1) add artifact checksum early in fetch pipeline 2) implement randomized warmup jitter to avoid herd 3) lower compile timeout threshold and enable more aggressive fallback 4) add alert for KV cache churn spikes.
sre_lead: agreed. Also schedule postmortem with infra + runtime + storage teams. Assigning owners: maria (artifact), devon (kernel selection), lee (warmup throttling), tomas (customer comms).
oncall: closing loop for now, monitoring for any regressions. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident updated: severity reduced to SEV-3, customer-impact mitigated, follow-up postmortem scheduled. Thread archived in 7 days.
